6.7.8 Practice Questions
Date: 10/17/2026, 5:16:02 PM
Time Spent: 00:15
Score: 0% Passing Score: 80%
A security analyst at a financial institution has discovered that sensitive customer data was
transferred outside of the organization's network.
Which of the following is the MOST likely explanation for the data transfer?
A Data exfiltration Correct
B Data backup
C Data replication
D Data archiving
Explanation
Data exfiltration refers to the unauthorized transfer of sensitive data from a secure network to
an external location.
Data backups refer to making a copy for safekeeping if the original data is lost or damaged.
Data backups are within the organization's network, not outside.
Data archiving refers to moving data not actively used to a separate storage location, typically
for long-term retention. Data archiving is within the organization's network, not outside of it.
Data replication refers to creating multiple copies of data for redundancy purposes, allowing
for continued access to the data even if one copy is lost or damaged. Replication is within the
organization's network, not outside.
Question 1 Incorrect
10/17/26, 5:18 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 1/11
Which of the following tools can you use to prevent data exfiltration by identifying and
blocking the transfer of sensitive information?
A FTP
B OneDrive
C WAF
D DLP Correct
Explanation
Organizations can employ advanced security solutions like data loss prevention (DLP)
software to identify and block the transfer of sensitive information by monitoring data in
motion, at rest, and in use.
File transfer protocols, such as FTP and SFTP, can be exploited for data exfiltration by
unauthorized individuals who gain access to sensitive files on a network and transfer them to
an external server.
OneDrive, Dropbox, or Google Drive can be used to receive exfiltrated data. Blocking
employees' access to the sites makes detecting malicious use easier.
An adversary may use SQL injection or similar techniques to copy records from a database
they should not have access to. Web Application Firewalls (WAF) can detect these injection
attacks. However, it is not designed to prevent data infiltration attacks.
Question 2 Incorrect
10/17/26, 5:18 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 2/11
A security consultant uses a software tool to perform security tests for an organization's cloud
presence.
Which tool will the consultant use in an attempt to gain a list of all virtual machine and
storage container instances?
A Nessus
B Arachni
C Scout Suite Correct
D OpenVAS
Explanation
Scout Suite is an audit tool that collects data such as security misconfigurations. The tool also
provides a report of discovered objects, such as virtual machines and containers, which is the
consultant's goal.
Arachni is an open-source web scanner that tests many vulnerabilities in HTML forms,
including code injection, structured query language (SQL) injection, and cross-site scripting
(XSS). However, Arachni is not useful to the consultant in this case.
OpenVAS is an open-source scanner used to identify vulnerabilities in systems. The consultant
could use OpenVas to obtain Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) scores but not for
object identification.
Nessus is a popular vulnerability assessment tool to gauge the risks associated with any
vulnerabilities based on several factors, including a CVSS score.

A coworker has run Scout Suite against your Microsoft Azure environment.
What were they looking for?
A Scout Suite is used to help increase efficiency of cloud resources.
B
Scout Suite is used to show potential security risks on
cloud deployments.
Correct
C
Scout Suite is used to determine software version risks on cloud
deployments.
D Scout Suite scans cloud deployments for viruses.
Explanation
Question 4 Incorrect
10/17/26, 5:18 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 4/11
Scout Suite is used to show potential security risks on cloud deployments. It can work with
multi-cloud environments (those that have services in more than one cloud environment). It is
designed to look for flaws in deployment, weak security policies, and other risky
configurations on cloud setups.
Scout Suite can determine some information about software versions or protocols, but its
primary function is to observe many different facets of a cloud environment, not just software
versions.
A secure environment will potentially provide some efficiency improvements, but this is only
from a security perspective. Generally speaking, the more locked-down an environment is, the
less efficient it will be, as additional safeguards consume additional time or resources.
Scout Suite does not scan for viruses.
10/17/26, 5:18 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 5/11
An organization moves computing resources to the cloud. A team of security consultants
reviews the new configurations and reports on the details from an external perspective.
As part of the investigation, the team takes advantage of regulatory compliance features of
what tool?
A ScoutSuite
B Prowler Correct
C GNU debugger (GDB)
D Pacu
Explanation
Prowler is an audit tool for use with Amazon Web Services (AWS) only. The consultants can use
this tool to evaluate the cloud infrastructure against the Center for Internet Security (CIS)
Benchmarks and perform regulatory compliance checks.
ScoutSuite is an audit tool that collects data such as security misconfigurations from a cloud
platform using application programming interface (API) calls. The consultants would not use
the tool for compliance checks.
Pacu is an exploitation framework and would be useful for the consultants to evaluate the
security of an AWS environment.
The consultants would use GNU Debugger to debug programs written in various
programming languages such as C, C++, and Fortran.
Question 5 Incorrect
10/17/26, 5:18 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 6/11
An organization moves computing resources to the cloud. A team of security consultants
performs penetration tests on a newly established install of AWS virtual machine instances.
Which resource does the team deploy to gain unauthorized access to these cloud resources?
A Immunity debugger
B Pacu Correct
C OpenVAS
D ScoutSuite
Explanation
Pacu is an exploitation framework and would be useful for the consultants to evaluate the
security of an Amazon Web Services (AWS) environment, including attempts to gain access.
The consultants use the Immunity Debugger tool to inspect malware. It is an advanced
debugger and analysis tool used in reverse engineering and debugging software.
ScoutSuite is an audit tool that collects data such as security misconfigurations from a cloud
platform using application programming interface (API) calls. However, the consultants would
not use the tool to gain access to cloud resources.
OpenVAS is an open-source scanner to identify vulnerabilities in systems. The security
consultants could use this tool to obtain Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) scores
but not to gain access.
Question 6 Incorrect
10/17/26, 5:18 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 7/11
A company's security team needs to assess the security posture of its Amazon Web Services
(AWS) environment, focusing on both the reconnaissance and exploitation phases of a
penetration testing engagement.
The team requires a tool that can automate various attack scenarios and validate the
effectiveness of its cloud security controls.
Which of the following tools is best suited for this task?
A Zed Attack Proxy (ZAP)
B Tenable.io
C Suricata
D Pacu Correct
Explanation
Pacu is an open-source Amazon Web Services (AWS) exploitation framework for penetration
testing engagements in AWS environments. It automates various attack scenarios and helps
validate the effectiveness of cloud security controls.
Zed Attack Proxy (ZAP) is an open-source web application security scanner that helps identify
vulnerabilities in web applications. It is not specifically for Amazon Web Services (AWS)
environment reconnaissance and exploitation.
Tenable.io is a cloud-based vulnerability management platform that helps organizations
identify and manage vulnerabilities in their infrastructure. It is not for Amazon Web Services
(AWS) environment reconnaissance and exploitation.
Suricata is an open-source network threat detection engine that provides intrusion detection
(IDS), intrusion prevention (IPS), and network security monitoring (NSM) functionalities.
Question 7 Incorrect
10/17/26, 5:18 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 8/11
Which security control layer involves putting in place policies that comply with industry
standards, such as OWASP?
A Network
B Application Correct
C Management
D Physical
Explanation
Security at the Application layer involves putting in place policies that comply with industry
standards, such as OWASP (Open Web Application Security Project).
The Management layer involves all administrative tasks to promote uninterrupted and
effective services.
The Network layer implements policies to prevent attackers from activities such as stealing,
modifying, viewing, and redirecting data.
Physical layer security measures focus on data centers, physical resources, and cloud
infrastructure.
Question 8 Incorrect
10/17/26, 5:18 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 9/11
A government agency had a breach at one of its locations that resulted in stolen hard drives.
The virtual servers on the stolen hard drives had data for only one virtual appliance
replicating to the secondary virtual appliance remotely.
A security investigation report showed that the agency did not set up virtual appliances with
data-at-rest security features.
What must the system administrators do to ensure another breach does not jeopardize the
government?
A Encrypt the virtual server Correct
B Setup backup targets
C Setup for disaster recovery
D Configure high availability
Explanation
Encryption provides data-at-rest security for virtual and physical servers at the drive level. For
example, if a hard drive gets stolen, the data is not recoverable without the decryption keys.
Backup targets provide the availability of data in the event it is lost or corrupted. In this case,
the agency set up the virtual servers for replication to another site.
High availability supports services if one of the cluster servers goes down. In this case, one of
the servers did go, but it did not protect the data from the breach.
Disaster recovery supports the availability of services after a catastrophic event. Here, stolen
data did not get protected, but services were still available on the second virtual server.
Question 9 Incorrect
10/17/26, 5:18 PM Individual Response
https://labsimapp.testout.com/exam-engine.html/redacted 10/11
Which security control makes a system more difficult to attack?
A Deterrent Correct
B Preventive
C Corrective
D Detective
Explanation
The table below describes the four types of security controls:
Type Description Deterrent Deterrent controls make a system more difficult to attack.
Preventive Preventive controls harden a system against attacks as well as recognize and stop
them. Detective Detective controls identify and take action as needed when incidents happen.
Corrective Corrective controls lessen the aftermath of an incident by limiting the damage.
